notes: Technical calibration only; no journal text or invented poetry.
Respellings are provisional aids until the author chooses a pronunciation authority.
Breath and whisper are texture categories, not extra ARPAbet phones. Their reviewed intervals may use HH or another explicitly chosen supported label; retain the category in take metadata.
No carrier phrase, reading style, vowel split, performance, palette or release choice has been selected.

prompts.instruction: Keep the selected microphone, gain and position fixed. Record ten seconds of the room without speaking. Leave all denoising and automatic gain control off when the device allows it.
prompts.label: Room reference

prompts.instruction: After choosing reading style and pronunciation reference, say the technical words 'one two three', then sustain the chosen AA vowel comfortably for two seconds. This is a level and session reference, not a performance instruction. Use a tuner only to document the pitch you naturally choose; no target pitch is prescribed.
prompts.label: Voice level/reference

target.respelling: one, two, three; then a comfortable 'ah' as defined by your chosen pronunciation reference
